SELECT
        (SELECT min(mono_ms) FROM obd WHERE vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND observed_at BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01') AS first_obd_ms,
        (SELECT max(mono_ms) FROM obd WHERE vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND observed_at BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01') AS last_obd_ms,
        (SELECT min(mono_ms) FROM (
    SELECT * FROM v_position_trusted
    WHERE vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND observed_at BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND trusted
      AND (coalesce(source_flags, 0) & 32 = 0
           OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v_position_trusted d
                          WHERE d.vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND d.observed_at BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND d.trusted AND coalesce(d.source_flags, 0) & 32 = 0
                            AND d.lat != 0 AND d.lon != 0))
  ) AS pos) AS first_pos_ms,
        (SELECT min(mono_ms) FROM (
    SELECT * FROM v_position_trusted
    WHERE vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND observed_at BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND trusted
      AND (coalesce(source_flags, 0) & 32 = 0
           OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v_position_trusted d
                          WHERE d.vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND d.observed_at BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND d.trusted AND coalesce(d.source_flags, 0) & 32 = 0
                            AND d.lat != 0 AND d.lon != 0))
  ) AS pos WHERE lat != 0 AND lon != 0) AS first_fix_ms

SELECT
        CASE
          WHEN o.load_pct < 20 THEN 'light'
          WHEN o.load_pct < 50 THEN 'medium'
          ELSE 'heavy'
        END as load_zone,
        avg(o.timing_advance_deg)::decimal(4,1) as avg_timing,
        avg(b.lambda_ratio)::decimal(5,3) as avg_lambda,
        avg(b.maf_cgps)::decimal(6,1) as avg_maf,
        avg(o.speed_kph)::decimal(5,1) as avg_speed,
        avg(o.rpm)::decimal(6,0) as avg_rpm,
        count(*) as samples
      FROM boost b
      ASOF JOIN obd o ON b.vehicle_id = o.vehicle_id AND b.boot_id = o.boot_id AND b.mono_ms >= o.mono_ms
      WHERE b.maf_cgps IS NOT NULL AND b.lambda_ratio IS NOT NULL
        AND b.lambda_ratio > 0.7 AND b.lambda_ratio < 1.3
        AND o.speed_kph IS NOT NULL AND o.speed_kph > 5
        AND o.rpm IS NOT NULL AND o.rpm > 0
        AND o.timing_advance_deg IS NOT NULL
        AND o.load_pct IS NOT NULL AND b.vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000'
      GROUP BY b.vehicle_id, load_zone
      ORDER BY avg_speed

SELECT
        count(*) AS imu_samples,
        round(max(abs(accel_peak_x_mg)) / 1000.0, 2) AS peak_long_g,
        round(max(abs(accel_peak_y_mg)) / 1000.0, 2) AS peak_lat_g,
        round(max(gyro_peak_dps), 1) AS peak_yaw_dps

SELECT

        max(rpm) AS peak_rpm,
        round(avg(CASE WHEN lambda_ratio > 0 THEN lambda_ratio END), 3) AS avg_lambda,

SELECT
        sum(CASE WHEN alt_diff > 0 THEN alt_diff ELSE 0 END) AS gain_m,
        sum(CASE WHEN alt_diff < 0 THEN abs(alt_diff) ELSE 0 END) AS loss_m
      FROM (
        SELECT alt_m - lag(alt_m) OVER (ORDER BY observed_at, mono_ms) AS alt_diff
        FROM (
    SELECT * FROM v_position_trusted
    WHERE vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND observed_at BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND trusted
      AND (coalesce(source_flags, 0) & 32 = 0
           OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v_position_trusted d
                          WHERE d.vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND d.observed_at BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND d.trusted AND coalesce(d.source_flags, 0) & 32 = 0
                            AND d.lat != 0 AND d.lon != 0))
  ) AS pos WHERE vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND observed_at BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND alt_m IS NOT NULL
      )

SELECT b.boost_psi,
        coalesce(o.intake_c,
          (SELECT o2.intake_c FROM obd o2
           WHERE o2.vehicle_id = b.vehicle_id AND o2.boot_id = b.boot_id AND o2.intake_c IS NOT NULL
           ORDER BY abs(o2.mono_ms::int - b.mono_ms::int) LIMIT 1)
        ) as intake_c,
        o.rpm
      FROM boost b
      ASOF JOIN obd o ON b.vehicle_id = o.vehicle_id AND b.boot_id = o.boot_id AND b.mono_ms >= o.mono_ms
      WHERE b.boost_psi > 0 AND b.vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000'
      ORDER BY b.boost_psi

SELECT b.boot_id,
        min(b.observed_at) as first_seen,
        avg(b.ltft_pct)::decimal(4,1) as avg_ltft,
        avg(b.stft_pct)::decimal(4,1) as avg_stft,
        avg(b.lambda_ratio)::decimal(5,3) as avg_lambda,
        max(b.maf_cgps) as peak_maf_cgps,
        count(*) as samples
      FROM boost b
      WHERE b.ltft_pct IS NOT NULL AND b.vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000'
      GROUP BY b.vehicle_id, b.boot_id
      ORDER BY first_seen

SELECT b.boot_id,
        min(b.observed_at) as first_seen,
        count(*) as samples,
        avg(o.speed_kph)::decimal(5,1) as avg_speed_kph,
        max(o.speed_kph) as max_speed_kph,
        avg(b.maf_cgps)::decimal(6,1) as avg_maf,
        avg(b.lambda_ratio)::decimal(5,3) as avg_lambda,
        avg(o.rpm)::decimal(6,0) as avg_rpm,
        avg(o.timing_advance_deg)::decimal(4,1) as avg_timing,
        avg(b.ltft_pct)::decimal(4,1) as avg_ltft,
        avg(o.load_pct)::decimal(4,1) as avg_load,
        (max(b.mono_ms) - min(b.mono_ms)) / 1000.0 as duration_s
      FROM boost b
      ASOF JOIN obd o ON b.vehicle_id = o.vehicle_id AND b.boot_id = o.boot_id AND b.mono_ms >= o.mono_ms
      WHERE b.maf_cgps IS NOT NULL AND b.lambda_ratio IS NOT NULL
        AND b.lambda_ratio > 0.7 AND b.lambda_ratio < 1.3
        AND o.speed_kph IS NOT NULL AND o.speed_kph > 5
        AND o.rpm IS NOT NULL AND o.rpm > 0 AND b.vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000'
      GROUP BY b.vehicle_id, b.boot_id
      ORDER BY first_seen

SELECT b.mono_ms, b.boot_id, o.rpm, b.boost_psi,

           WHERE o2.vehicle_id = b.vehicle_id AND o2.boot_id = b.boot_id AND o2.intake_c IS NOT NULL
           ORDER BY abs(o2.mono_ms::int - b.mono_ms::int) LIMIT 1)
        ) as intake_c,
        b.lambda_ratio, b.maf_cgps, o.timing_advance_deg
      FROM boost b
      ASOF JOIN obd o ON b.vehicle_id = o.vehicle_id AND b.boot_id = o.boot_id AND b.mono_ms >= o.mono_ms
      WHERE b.boost_psi IS NOT NULL AND b.vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000'
      ORDER BY o.rpm

      FROM boost b
      JOIN obd o ON b.vehicle_id = o.vehicle_id AND b.boot_id = o.boot_id

      WHERE b.maf_cgps IS NOT NULL AND b.lambda_ratio IS NOT NULL

        speed_mps * least(greatest(epoch_ms(lead_at) - epoch_ms(observed_at), 0), 10000) / 1000.0
      ), 0) AS distance_m
      FROM (
        SELECT observed_at, speed_mps,
          lead(observed_at) OVER (ORDER BY observed_at, mono_ms) AS lead_at
        FROM (
    SELECT * FROM v_position_trusted
    WHERE vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND observed_at BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND trusted
      AND (coalesce(source_flags, 0) & 32 = 0
           OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v_position_trusted d
                          WHERE d.vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND d.observed_at BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND d.trusted AND coalesce(d.source_flags, 0) & 32 = 0
                            AND d.lat != 0 AND d.lon != 0))
  ) AS pos WHERE vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND observed_at BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01' AND speed_mps IS NOT NULL
      ) WHERE lead_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT p.lat, p.lon, p.observed_at
      FROM position p
      JOIN (
        SELECT started_at, ended_at FROM v_trip_summary
        WHERE vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000'
          AND ended_at < TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01'
        ORDER BY ended_at DESC
        LIMIT 1
      ) prev
        ON p.vehicle_id = '00000000000000000000000000000000'
       AND p.observed_at BETWEEN prev.started_at AND prev.ended_at
      WHERE p.lat != 0 AND p.lon != 0
      ORDER BY p.observed_at DESC, p.mono_ms DESC
      LIMIT 1

SELECT

      d.duration_s,
      d.max_speed_kph,
      fp.observed_at AS start_time,
      fp.lat AS start_lat,
      fp.lon AS start_lon,
      lp.lat AS end_lat,
      lp.lon AS end_lon
    FROM v_drive_summary d
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT boot_id, observed_at, lat, lon
      FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY boot_id ORDER BY mono_ms ASC) AS rn FROM position WHERE lat != 0 AND lon != 0) WHERE rn = 1
    ) fp USING (boot_id)
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT boot_id, lat, lon
      FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY boot_id ORDER BY mono_ms DESC) AS rn FROM position WHERE lat != 0 AND lon != 0) WHERE rn = 1
    ) lp USING (boot_id)
    ORDER BY fp.observed_at DESC

SELECT t.*,
      t.started_at AS start_time,
      first_fix.lat AS start_lat,
      first_fix.lon AS start_lon
    FROM v_trip_summary t
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT vehicle_id, trip_started_at, lat, lon FROM (
        SELECT p.vehicle_id, s.started_at AS trip_started_at, p.lat, p.lon,
               row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.vehicle_id, s.started_at
                                  ORDER BY p.observed_at ASC) AS rn
        FROM position p
        JOIN v_trip_summary s
          ON s.vehicle_id = p.vehicle_id
         AND p.observed_at BETWEEN s.started_at AND s.ended_at
        WHERE p.lat != 0 AND p.lon != 0
      ) WHERE rn = 1
    ) first_fix
      ON first_fix.vehicle_id = t.vehicle_id AND first_fix.trip_started_at = t.started_at
    
    ORDER BY duration_ms DESC
    LIMIT 200 OFFSET 0

WITH recent AS (
      SELECT * FROM v_trip_summary t ORDER BY t.started_at DESC LIMIT 5
    ), fixes AS (
      SELECT r.trip_id, p.lat, p.lon,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.trip_id ORDER BY p.observed_at ASC, p.mono_ms ASC) AS rn_first,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.trip_id ORDER BY p.observed_at DESC, p.mono_ms DESC) AS rn_last
      FROM recent r
      JOIN v_position_trusted p
        ON p.vehicle_id = r.vehicle_id AND p.observed_at BETWEEN r.started_at AND r.ended_at
      WHERE p.trusted AND p.lat != 0 AND p.lon != 0
    )
    SELECT r.*,
      r.duration_ms / 1000.0 AS duration_s,
      r.max_obd_speed_kph AS max_speed_kph,
      r.started_at AS start_time,
      f1.lat AS start_lat, f1.lon AS start_lon,
      f2.lat AS end_lat, f2.lon AS end_lon
    FROM recent r
    LEFT JOIN fixes f1 ON f1.trip_id = r.trip_id AND f1.rn_first = 1
    LEFT JOIN fixes f2 ON f2.trip_id = r.trip_id AND f2.rn_last = 1
    ORDER BY r.started_at DESC
